apps.name: LiveRedirect
apps.subtitle: Redirect any URLs to LiveContainer! (iOS <26)
apps.localizedDescription:
Open matching webpages in LiveContainer from Safari on iOS using a lightweight Safari Web Extension.

What it does:
• Lets you maintain a list of URL or domain patterns (e.g., discord.com/invite, youtube.com).
• When a visited page matches, the content script encodes the full URL as Base64 and redirects to: livecontainer://open-web-page?url=<base64>
• Manage patterns directly in the extension popup (add, delete, import, export).

Using the extension:
Important: Sideload with app extensions enabled to use extension!
• Add a pattern such as discord.com/invite or just github.com.
• Visit a matching page; you should be redirected to the LiveContainer URL.
• Import/Export via clipboard (JSON or newline list). The popup performs clipboard reads/writes only on user action.

MAME stands for Multi Arcade Machine Emulator. This app lets you play arcade games from the past 30+ years on your iPhone, iPad, macOS, or AppleTV.

Other nifty features include:
* 64-bit binary to run on modern and future iOS devices

* A native Metal rendering engine (by @ToddLa, new in 2020!)
* tvOS support (new in 2019!)
* An in-app web server to transfer files from your computer (new in 2019!)

versions.localizedDescription:
JIT (iOS 26 & Earlier)

- Implemented broad JIT support compatible with iOS 26 and earlier versions
- Integrated support for StikDebug’s universal.js launcher (Special thanks to @Stossy11)
- Added JIT support for:
    - 3DS (Citra)
    - Dreamcast (Flycast)
    - Nintendo DS (melonDS)
    - Nintendo 64 (GLideN64 RDP / mupen64plus.next  Special thanks to  @Fareblyat)
    - DOS (dosbox-pure)
    - PlayStation 1 (beetle-psx)
    - Added setting to enable/re-enable JIT directly from the app
    - Improved JIT handling flow for iOS 26 (automatic redirect to reinitialize when required)

Core & Emulator Updates

- Updated 3DS (Azahar) to latest upstream
- Updated PSP (PPSSPP) to latest upstream
- Added SNES core (snes9x; sideloaded availability)
- Added PS1 core (PCSX-ReARMed)

3DS Improvements

- Fixed Vulkan-related crashes (Azahar)
- Fixed Home Menu compilation and freezing issues
- Added Artic Base Home Menu support
- Added support for transferring data from real hardware via Artic Base
- Added Pretendo network configuration support
- Improved Home Menu integration (direct install logic)
- Added fast-forward support (Citra)
- Added full-screen AirPlay mirroring (Citra)

PSP

- Added support for installing homebrew via ZIP import

DOS

- Added thumbstick to default DOS skin
- Fixed legacy JIT crash issues

J2ME

- Performance optimizations (J2meJS)

Controls & Input

- Fixed numeric keypad mapping issues
- Added support for direct native keyboard event mapping
- Improved controller mapping compatibility
- TriggerPro now supports native keyboard event mapping

UI & Customization

- Added new app icons
- Added default emulator core selection setting
- Added “Hide Platform” feature
- Added manufacturer-based sorting
- Fixed general UI issues
- Improved theme customization options

Library / Platform Organization

- Game Boy can now be categorized as Chromatic (CHM)
- DOS can now be categorized under Windows 95 / Windows 98

General Fixes & Stability

- Fixed multiple UI and transition issues
- Improved overall system stability across cores and features

This is a major release focused on a redesigned interface, expanded platform support, and advanced features. Landscape browsing, library management, and external controller navigation have been rebuilt. It also adds several new systems and brings Netplay to eligible Libretro cores.

Before You Update
- Dreamcast (Flycast): Existing save states will no longer work as of 2.0.0. Convert important save states to in-game saves before updating, or back up the `Flycast/dc` folder yourself.
- Wii: A BootMii-format `keys.bin` is required.
- Symbian: Install firmware in Settings first (`.ROM`; S60v2 and later also need `.RPKG`).
- GameCube / Wii: The core is still being optimized, so heat and frame drops should still be expected.
- MAME: A number of lesser-used arcade systems have been trimmed. Some obscure titles may no longer run.

Interface
Landscape
- A new landscape library, with most landscape pages redesigned.
- Built-in dynamic backgrounds. You can use or upload ShaderToy (GLSL) scripts to customize them. Only single-Image scripts are supported; complex scripts may increase battery use or heat.
- Multiple customizable card carousel styles.
- Focused background: when a game is selected, its banner can be used as the landscape focus backdrop.
- background music feature in landscape mode—besides built-in tracks, you can upload your own music files to use as background music.
- built in 12 sets of navigation and focus sound effects.

Game Options and Shortcuts
- A unified options list and interaction model throughout the app.
- Available actions are automatically arranged and regrouped for the current context.
- Advanced reordering: customize the order and grouping of options.
- A redesigned in-game shortcut menu. Shortcuts can appear on supported skins and in the in-game menu.

Navigation and Input
- A global focus and navigation system for iPhone and iPad. You can browse and interact entirely with a controller or keyboard.
- Hold Command or the controller’s Select button to view the shortcut cheatsheet.
- A unified navigation bar for more consistent browsing and editing.
- Many long-press and hidden actions have been replaced with more conventional, iOS-style interactions.
- Batch management and actions.
- Adaptive rotation throughout the app.
- Controllers can be assigned to a player slot. On cores that expect a keyboard, controller inputs can be mapped to keyboard events.

Features
Library and Artwork
- Covers now support separate icon and banner artwork. Box art is used in regular lists, icons in square layouts, and banners as the landscape focus backdrop.
- Online artwork from Libretro Thumbnails and SteamGridDB (Grids / Heroes / Logos / Icons; SteamGridDB requires your own API key).
- Switching platform or category rematches cover art.

Game Data
- Game metadata: auto-match, search the database, or edit it yourself (developer, publisher, series, genre, release date, region, overview, and more).
- ESRB ratings and matching icons. Rating icons can be hidden in Settings.
- A redesigned save-state manager with import and export.
- Scoped settings: the same option can be stored at game, platform, or global level, and each can be cleared or reset independently.
- batch scraping for covers, icons, and banners.

Shaders and Skins
- Real-time shader preview, without loading the shader first.
- Redesigned default GBA skin.
- Flex skins now support customizing button size and position.

Achievements, Cheats, and Netplay
- RetroAchievements pages are easier to read and load faster.
- MultiSet support: earn subset achievements without a patched ROM. Switching the achievement list only changes what is shown; it does not affect which sets you can unlock while playing.
- Online cheat database: search, multi-select add, and bookmarks.
- Netplay for many Libretro cores: host or join a room, public lobby, LAN scan, relay, spectator mode, and room password. Your Adventurer Card nickname is used as the Netplay display name. You can now trade trea

- Added WonderSwan support
- Added NAOMI, Atomiswave, and System SP arcade support
- Added Flash support
  · Skin button binding
  · Hardware keyboard input
  · Software keyboard input
  · Touch input
- Built-in, self-contained JIT — no external debugger required
- Added Slow Motion
- Improved GameCube and Wii performance
- GameCube now supports multi-disc games
- Improved Wii motion controls
- Simulate the Wii IR pointer by touch
- Add games from other emulators via a link
- Fixed some arcade systems that wouldn’t run
- Fixed Dreamcast games running too fast
- Fixed PSP crashes
- Added NDS lid open/close
- Improved rotation: with orientation lock on in Control Center, the app no longer snaps back to portrait
- In-game shortcut tips can now be turned off
- Landscape library can disable carousel style
- Smoother landscape carousel scrolling
- MultiDisc Helper supports more formats
- Hardware keyboard input for Symbian, Amiga, and C64
- Added RomM support
  · LAN self-hosted servers only
  · Sync only for games imported from RomM
  · Manual sync only, from the service card’s long-press menu
  · Pull ROMs, covers, metadata, manuals, and game saves
- Fixed a launch timeout that could quit the app on older devices
- N64 now supports ROMs larger than 64 MB

apps.name: MeloNX
apps.subtitle: A Nintendo Switch Emulator based on Ryujinx for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
MeloNX

    MeloNX enables Nintendo Switch game emulation on iOS using Ryujinx as a base.
  

    MeloNX is an iOS Nintendo Switch emulator based on Ryujinx, written primarily in C# and Swift. Designed to bring accurate performance and a user-friendly interface to iOS, MeloNX makes Switch games accessible on Apple devices.
    Developed from the ground up, MeloNX is open-source and available on Github under the GPLv3 license.
  

FAQ
Where's the prod.keys file?/Where can I download [game]?
We do not support piracy, It is forbidden to request copyrighted content 
(Firmware/Games/Keys/Shaders) on our repositories or on the MeloNX Discord.
Do I need a Switch to use this emulator?
MeloNX emulator is capable of running many homebrew applications, and can be a crucial tool in the development and debugging of homebrew applications and games. To play commercial games, you will need access to a Switch compatible with custom firmware (CFW), which will enable you to dump your system firmware, keys and legally purchased games.
How can I dump my firmware/games/keys?
First, you need to hack your Nintendo Switch, which you can learn how to do here: https://nh-server.github.io/switch-guide/.
Once you have hacked your Switch, backed up your keys and dumped your firmware, you may follow these guides to dump keys, updates and DLC, firmware and games:
Keys
Games, Updates and DLC
Firmware
Info

A Paid Developer account or TrollStore may be needed for specific devices (Read about Entitlements below)
MeloNX REQUIRES JIT and CANNOT run without it.
Recommended iPhone: iPhone 15 Pro+ (8/12GB RAM both have the same memory limit of 6GB)
Recommended iPad: iPad Pro 5th+ 128GB+ (8GB RAM) / 1TB+ (16GB RAM) or iPad Air 5+ (8GB RAM)
Lowest Compatible Device (Paid Developer Account): iPhone 6s (iOS 15)
Lowest Compatible Device (Free Developer Account): iPhone 12

Entitlements

Entitlements are the underlying security permissions that allow an app to access specific features of your device

MeloNX can use 2 Entitlements:
Increased Memory Limit:
- This allows MeloNX to be able to use the most amount of ram apple lets us.
Extended Virtual Addressing:
- This allows MeloNX to be able to ask iOS for more memory / RAM then actually available.
- Extended Virtual Addressing is a PAID entitlement, TrollStore also gives this entitlement.
Increased Memory Limit is required for all devices.
Extended Virtual Addressing is required for specific devices which don't allow us to ask the RAM we need without the Extended Virtual Addressing entitlement.
Those Devices include:
iPads with less than 8GB of RAM.
iPhones with less than 4GB of RAM.
Discord Server
We have a discord server!
- https://discord.gg/HjCDPTpC3W
How to install
Recommended Guide (Plumeimpactor)

SideStore is recommended (optional) for an on-device Sideloader, and should be installed prior performing this install.

Make sure to read the FAQ and Info before continuing.
1. Sideload Application
Download and install MeloNX using PlumeImpactor on a computer.
- Download MeloNX From Releases
- Open PlumeImpactor > Click Settings > Click Login
- Login with the same Apple ID you are using for SideStore (or AltStore).
- Import the MeloNX .ipa you downloaded earlier.
- Plug in your iDevice.
- Select your iDevice from the dropdown at the top of the window.
- Click Install.
2. Load Into SideStore (Optional)
To have MeloNX show inside SideStore (or AltStore), You must re-install it:
- Open SideStore on your iDevice
- Select the My Apps tab > Tap the + button.
- Select the MeloNX .ipa (You may need to download it again.)
- Wait for it to Sideload, then it should show up Inside SideStore.
- Now You can Refresh MeloNX and Update it without needing a computer.
4. Setup Files

Add Encryption Keys and Firmware using the file picker inside MeloNX,
Information for where to get these files are here

5. Enable JIT

Enable JIT using your preferred method, on iOS 26 StikDebug is required.

Paid Developer Account (Legacy)
Make sure to read the FAQ and Info before continuing.
1. Sideload MeloNX
Download and install MeloNX using your preferred Apple ID (NOT CERT) sideloader:

2. Enable Memory Entitlement

Visit Apple Developer Identifiers.
Locate MeloNX and enable the following entitlements:

3. Reinstall MeloNX

Free Developer Account (Legacy, On-Device)

This Guide is out of date and not recommended unless REQUIRED. Please follow the recommended guide here.
SideStore is recommended to Sideload MeloNX.

Make sure to read the FAQ and Info before continuing.
The Entitlement App is *NOT needed for AltStore Classic***
- You may skip Step 2 and Step 3
1. Sideload Applications
Download and install both apps using your preferred APPLE ID sideloader:
- MeloNX: Download from Releases
- Entitlement App: Download IPA
2. Enable Memory Entitlement

If the Entitlement / GetMoreRam app isn't working correctly, then try the new Plumeimpactor method.
- Open the Entitlement app > Settings
- Sign in with the same Apple ID you used to Sideload MeloNX.
- Go to App IDs > tap Refresh
- Select MeloNX (e.g., "com.stossy11.MeloNX.XXXXXX")
- Tap Add Increased Memory Limit

3. Reinstall MeloNX

4. Setup Files

Information for where to get these files are here

5. Enable JIT

Enable JIT using your preferred method. We recommend StikDebug.

Features
- Audio
Audio output is entirely supported, audio input (microphone) isn't supported.
We use C# wrappers for OpenAL, and SDL2 & libsoundio as fallbacks.
- CPU
The CPU emulator, ARMeilleure, emulates an ARMv8 CPU and currently has support for most 64-bit ARMv8 and some of the ARMv7 (and older) instructions, including partial 32-bit support.
It translates the ARM code to a custom IR, performs a few optimizations, and turns that into x86 code.
There are three memory manager options available depending on the user's preference, leveraging both software-based (slower) and host-mapped modes (much faster).
The fastest option (host, unchecked) is set by default.
Ryujinx also features an optional Profiled Persistent Translation Cache, which essentially caches translated functions so that they do not need to be translated every time the game loads.
The net result is a significant reduction in load times (the amount of time between launching a game and arriving at the title screen) for nearly every game.
NOTE: This feature is enabled by default, You must launch the game at least twice to the title screen or beyond before performance improvements are unlocked on the third launch!
These improvements are permanent and do not require any extra launches going forward.
- GPU
The GPU emulator emulates the Switch's Maxwell GPU using Metal (via MoltenVK) APIs through a custom build of Silk.NET.
- Input
We currently have support for keyboard, touch input, JoyCon input support, and nearly all MFI controllers.
Motion controls are natively supported in most cases, however JoyCons do not have motion support due to an iOS limitation.
Rumble is also natively supported in most cases.
- DLC & Modifications
MeloNX supports DLC + Game Update Add-ons.
Mods (romfs, exefs, and runtime mods such as cheats) are unsupported; but may work. 
- Configuration
The emulator has settings for enabling or disabling logging, remapping controllers, resolution settings, Shader Cache and more.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Mini vMac for iOS v2.6

* Added 512×384 variant of Mac II
* Requires iOS 13.4
    * Dropping 32-bit support (iOS 9) made the app smaller
* Prefer pixel-perfect scaling when display scaling filter is set to nearest
* Auto-hide iOS home indicator
* Partially fix some command-key shortcuts going to iOS instead of the emulated Mac (#45)
    * ⌘-w and most others will get passed to the emulated machine if it's running
    * ⌘-q and ⌘-h don't seem interceptable, the app doesn't receive any key events for them, but ⌘-q doesn't do anything (or maybe it does in some other configuration?), and ⌘-h will take you to the home screen
* visionOS support (only tested in simulator)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zydeco/minivmac4ios/compare/v2.5...v2.6

# Mini vMac for iOS 2.5

* Update to Mini vMac 37.03 beta
* Fixed crash when deleting disk images on iPad
* Adds recently used disks to quick actions menu
* Removed custom presentation modes for disk and settings screens
* Doesn't show "The developer of this app needs to update it to work with this version of iOS" error when installing IPA on iOS 15

apps.name: OldOS
apps.subtitle: OldOS is a testament to the days of iOS 4.
apps.localizedDescription:
OldOS is a testament to the days of yesteryear, showcasing what iOS once was ten years ago. The ethos of the app is to merge the technologies of today with a pixel-perfect recreation of the user experience of the past. The vast majority of apps in OldOS are fully functional — meaning they seamlessly integrate with the data on your phone to deliver a live, emulator-esque experience. What does this mean? Well, you can play your music in iPod, get directions in Maps, surf the web in Safari, view the current weather in Weather, and much more. By the same token, no shortcuts were taken in fully fleshing out the operating system. You can change your background, adjust settings, search apps, et cetera. There are a few apps still not ready for primetime but don't worry, they're coming soon.

With OldOS, you no longer need to worry about securing a legacy iPhone to experience nostalgia — it's available on your daily driver.

Part of the goal with OldOS is to enable anyone to understand how iOS works and demonstrate just how powerful SwiftUI truly is. For that reason, the entire app is open-sourced — enabling developers to learn about, modify, and add to the app. I thought building this over my last six or so months in high school and sharing it with the world would be a fun and productive endeavor.

Special Features:
* 🧑‍💻 Built almost entirely using SwiftUI.
* 🎨 Designed to be as close to pixel-perfect as possible.
* 📱 Fully functional, perhaps even usable as a second OS.
* ❤️ A testament to the work of Apple employees of both the past and the present.
* 🗺️ Fully open source for all to learn, modify, and build on.

# IPA V2.0 Build 7

2.0 (7):
- New Weather backend and added performance improvements
- Updated home button 
- Everything else in 2.0 (1) - 2.0 (6)

NOTE: BundleIdentifier changed in this version and automatic updates have been disabled until manual install occurs.

# IPA V2.0 Build 1

2.0 (1):

Where to begin. I think, first and foremost a sorry is in order — college, life, work all got in the way. This update, and my goal with it, is to bring the project back from the dead so to speak. In doing so, the codebase has been retooled and refactored, APIs have been restored, and compilation errors have been resolved. In the same vein, all (or maybe most?) bugs related to changes in iOS/Swift/SwiftUI over the past few years have been resolved. My goal is to put a new foundation in place to begin building on top of again. In other words, 2.0 returns OldOS to how it once was (and improves it perhaps too).

apps.localizedDescription:
PancakeStore
Exploit-less app store downgrader based off of MuffinStore Jailed.
Supports iOS 16.4 and later.
Latest Release • Discord Server • Our Website


[!WARNING]
Logging in may break at random due to Apple's constant server-side changes. If login fails, make sure that you're on the latest version of PancakeStore. Do NOT open any issues or ask for support regading logins. It will not speed up the process of fixing authentication.

Before you continue...

Not only is authentication unstable, but there is no guarantee that user data will be retained when downgrading! Use this tool at your own risk.

Installation
Please make sure that the following requirements are met:
- Your device is running iOS 16.4 or later.
- You have an Apple ID with 2FA enabled (highly recommended to be the one your iDevice is signed in with).
- You have a sideloading method of your choice to install this tool. Almost all methods of sideloading, including TrollStore and LiveContainer, are supported.
Usage
The target app must meet the following requirements:
- This app has been purchased from the App Store with the same Apple ID you're using to log in.
- The app isn't installed on your device (offloading works).
- The app actually has vaild versions to downgrade to (some don't, so keep this in mind).

Do NOT ask for support if a specific app can't be downgraded or crashes on launch. There is nothing we can do about this.

Troubleshooting

"Failed to get pod" error: This usually means that logging in will be impossible on this Apple ID, or that a server-side change has broke authentication. Please don't open any issues or ask for support if you get this error.
"Safari can't open the page" error: Go to Settings > Apps > Safari, and under "Privacy & Security," disable "Not Secure Connection Warning." Also ensure that you don't have any VPN or DNS settings that might be affecting this.

Credits

Mineek: Created the original project.
skadz108: Project maintainer, backend developer, and various authentication fixes.
lunginspector: Frontend manager and QoL improvements.

Thank you everybody for your patience and support! Working slowly to make things more stable, hopefully less impatient complaints make their way to us...

Users can utilize their own PSP games by converting them into .ISO or .CSO files, or explore free homemade games through the built-in Homebrew Store. The app operates independently of Sony and does not include games with the download.

apps.name: Provenance
apps.subtitle: An iOS Frontend for Multiple Emulators
apps.localizedDescription:
Relive the golden age of gaming.

Provenance brings together a collection of classic gaming console emulators into a single app for your iPhone or iPad, with support for Apple Game Controllers for that authentic experience.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's New in 3.3.0

This is a big one. Four months of work since 3.2.1 covering iCloud sync, a completely revamped tvOS interface, video filters, and a ton of core and stability fixes.

### ☁️ iCloud / CloudKit Sync
- ROMs, save states, BIOS files, and artwork now sync across devices via iCloud
- Real-time download progress indicators when loading cloud save states
- Auto BIOS sync on game load when available in iCloud
- ROM metadata syncs alongside files
- Artwork syncs after library updates
- CloudKit records management tab in Settings
- iCloud upsell UI for new users with empty libraries
- Sync queue pauses during emulation and resumes after

### 📺 New tvOS UI (Default)
- Completely redesigned tvOS interface now enabled by default
- RetroWave-themed side menu with smooth animations
- Save states browser accessible from the main UI with artwork and core name
- "View All" saves section with per-system filtering
- TopShelf v2: recent games and save states with artwork and timestamps
- Cheats UI in the pause menu
- Game "More Info" panel
- Log viewer tab
- Import status view in side menu
- Search with persistent history
- Dozens of focus, navigation, and theming fixes throughout

### 🎨 Video Filters & Shaders
- Unified filter pipeline works across native and RetroArch cores
- GB and VHS filters improved
- Filters accessible from the pause menu
- RetroArch GLES 3D cores now supported (Vecx/GLiden, etc.)
- Dolphin shader/filter support
- PPSSPP filter support

### 🎮 Core & Controller Fixes
- **RetroArch**: Fixed player index mapping for MFi, PS4, and Xbox controllers; PS4 start/select fixed; 32x controls added; GameCube controller responder added
- **Mupen64Plus**: Fixed PS4 start button; fixed tvOS scaling and placement; better save error messages
- **Dolphin**: Fixed Vulkan landscape rendering
- **GenPluGX**: Added CHD support; added wide-screen GameGear core
- **PicoDrive**: Fixed crash on unload; fixed 32x controller mapping
- **FCEUmm**: Fixed start/select button mapping
- **Mednafen**: Fixed DualShock/DualSense pause/play button mapping
- **GameBatte / TGDB Dual**: Fixed PSX/Xbox pause/select button mapping

### 🐛 Bug Fixes & Stability
- Fixed multiple app hangs from main-thread Realm access (moved to background)
- Fixed crash in pause menu when closing core
- Fixed potential crash if audio ring buffer init fails
- Fixed crash in share/import extension
- Fixed aspect ratio issues in Stella and some other cores
- Fixed FPS label appearing in screenshots
- Fixed artwork not refreshing in game library after sync
- Fixed game importer re-queuing already-imported items
- Fixed Realm contentless core crash
- Fixed "Continue" carousel metadata mismatch
- Skin selector refreshes orientation previews on rotation change
- ManicSkin/DeltaSkin files can n

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Provenance-Emu/Provenance/compare/3.2.0...3.2.1

Bug fixes:

- iPad skins fixed
- Joystick in default skin fixed in landscape
- Atari Lynx Retroach controls fixed
- RetroAchievements login fixed
- Skin selection and import UIs fixed
- Skin rotation issues fixed
- Skin previews fixed

# Release 3.2.0

We're excited to announce Provenance 3.2.0, a major update focused on performance, skins, and quality of life improvements. This release brings highly requested features and fixes that make Provenance faster and more enjoyable than ever.

## 🎨 Skins: Now Free for Everyone!

The biggest news: **Full skin support is now available to all users—no Provenance Plus required!** We believe everyone should enjoy customizing their gaming experience. However, if you love what we're building, please consider supporting the project through [Provenance Plus](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/provenance-app/id1596862805) or [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/provenance).

### What's New with Skins

- **Full Manic and Delta Skin Support** for all systems (except 3DS and DS—those are coming soon!)
- **Dramatically Improved Performance**: Faster rendering, loading, and smoother UI
- **Fixed Rotation Issues**: No more slow redraws when changing orientation
- **Memory Optimizations**: More efficient skin storage and rendering
- **RetroArch Core Support**: Skins now work across all emulator cores
- **Enhanced Skin Browser**: Faster, more responsive skin selection and preview

## ⚡ Performance Improvements

### Library & UI
- **Faster Main Library**: Significantly improved scrolling and navigation performance
- **Optimized Rendering Loop**: Better frame pacing and smoother gameplay across all cores

### Core Performance
- **Dreamcast/Flycast Enhancements**:
  - Faster emulation speed
  - Windows CE-based games now supported
  - Full networking support enabled
- **emuThreeDS (3DS Core)**: Performance bump and reduced graphic glitches
- **PPSSPP**: More options exposed, layout fixes, and full skin support

### ROM Management
- **Rewritten ROM Importer**:
  - Batch processing for multiple imports
  - Significantly improved artwork matching—more comprehensive, faster, and more accurate
  - Much faster and more reliable with fewer errors
  - Fixed bug where existing ROMs were repeatedly re-imported
  - Eliminated erroneous duplicate imports
  - **7zip Archive Support**: Fixed large 7zip archive handling
- **MAME/CPS ZIP Support**: Drop MAME/CPS1,2,3 ZIP files directly into imports or the MAME/CPS ROMs folder—they'll import and load correctly!

## 🐛 Major Bug Fixes

### Core Stability
- **GameCube/Wii (Dolphin) Improvements**:
  - Fixed flickering after pause/resume
  - Fixed mis-mapped button inputs
  - Corrected inverted settings
  - Faster access to overclock/underclock settings
  - Performance improvements matching dedicated emulator apps
- **Atari ST**: No longer crashes at boot
- **Vectrex**: Fixed core booting and blank video output
- **Mednafen**: Fixed static audio in CHD files with FLAC compression
- **Odyssey2**: Added numpad button support (can now selec

apps.name: Provenance
apps.subtitle: A multi-platform emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
Relive the golden age of gaming. Provenance brings together a collection of classic gaming console emulators into a single app for your iPhone or iPad, with support for Apple Game Controllers for that authentic experience.

Provenance supports Nintendo, Sega, Sony, Atari, NEC, SNK, and Bandai console systems.

NINTENDO : (NES) Famicom / Nintendo Entertainment System, Famicom Disk System, (SNES) Super Famicom /Super  Nintendo Entertainment System), Gameboy, Gameboy Color, Gameboy Advance, Pokemon Mini, Virtual Boy and Nintendo 64

SEGA : SG-1000, Master System, Genesis / Mega Drive, Mega-CD / CD, Game Gear, 32X and Saturn

Sony : PlayStation 1 

ATARI : 2600 / Video Computer System, 5200 / SuperSystem, 7800 / Pro System, Lynx, Jaguar

Bandai : WonderSwan and WonderSwan Color

SNK : Neo Geo Pocket and Neo Geo Pocket Color

NEC : PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16 Entertainment SuperSystem (CD), PC Engine Super CD-ROM System / TurboGrafx-CD, PC Engine SuperGrafx, and PC-FX

apps.name: Ready
apps.subtitle: 8-bit games for your iPad.
apps.localizedDescription:
Ready is an open source emulator for the following 8 bit home computers:
* Commodore 64
* Commodore VIC-20
* Commodore 16, Plus/4
* Sinclair ZX Spectrum (16k, 48k, Spectrum+, 128k, +2)

With preliminary support for these computers:
* Atari 600XL, 800XL
* Commodore 128
* Commander X16

It is based on atari800, fuse, Vice, and x16-emulator, which provide accurate emulation of many hardware variants and peripherals. Ready requires at least iPadOS 13.5.

Ready aims to approximate the feeling of using actual hardware. Rather than configuring abstract settings, you select hardware components. The software keyboard is a facsimile of the original, reflecting the different existing styles. Even the noise of the disk drive is emulated. The Library section offers a way to organize a large collection of games, demos and programs. The emulated hardware can be customized for each entry.

The Inbox provides a place to quickly try new programs. You can easily move the ones you want to keep to the library.

Tools mode allows attaching a cartridge like Action Replay or Final Cartridge and a collection of disks with your favorite tools, to help you dig into the programs, like back in the day.

apps.name: Regram (Duplicate)
apps.subtitle: The all-in-one tweak for Instagram
apps.localizedDescription:
This is a duplicated app, it can be installed alongside original Instagram (Bundle ID com.fouadraheb.regram).

Regram is your all-in-one tweak for Instagram.

Currently available only to Patreon subscribers. Activate license by connecting your Patreon account from inside Regram Settings.

Access Regram settings by long-pressing on Home tab bar button or from Instagram settings.

versions.localizedDescription:
This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes and compatibility updates for IG 454.1.
- Settings rebuilt: new Search to find any setting, faster, new layout, one place per setting, setting links and "New" tags.
- New update check: new versions show at the top of Settings, Update opens your installer app (Feather, AltStore, Sileo...). Can be turned off.
- Privacy: hide your followers & following lists from others, and hide yourself from other people's lists. Saved on your IG account, so it works for everyone.
- iPhone Duo support: Tab Bar editor, feed header button and story buttons now work, folded or unfolded.
- Profile Analyzer rewritten: new native dashboard, one list screen with search, filters, notes & tags, batch follow/unfollow with safety caps, scan history timeline + compare, Growth page (iOS 16+), ghost followers and export.
- Stories Archive rewrite: new Insights (vs the period before, audience, best story & time, top viewers), Story trends charts (iOS 16+), People list with verified & private marks, new viewer profile (seen strip, follow status, timeline filters), saves sticker reactions & votes.
- Reels: Picture in Picture When Leaving — leave IG while a reel plays and it keeps playing in a floating window (IG's own player).
- Feed: Floating Stories Bar (iOS 26+) — a hidden IG feature Regram turns on: the stories bar shrinks into a floating bubble as you scroll; tap it to watch.
- IG Feature Flags (Tools): turn IG's hidden features on/off, search ~38k flags, share links; Try These page of tested picks (e.g. Extra Story Text Styles); crash guard undoes bad changes. Account-security flags are read-only.
- Shortcuts & Links (App Utilities): links that open Regram screens or turn any setting on/off from Shortcuts; asks first unless Skip Confirmation is on. Setting links now work on jailbreak too.
- Media Vault: new photo & video editor, Info screen, Post to IG, rebuilt folders (nested, smart, locked), Date filter and more tools..
- New Show Reel Date (Settings > Reels): see when a reel was posted, above the author; tap for the full date. Custom date format.
- New Show Repost Date (Settings > Reels): tap a repost's avatar on a post or reel to see when they reposted it, when their note expires, and all reposts.
- New Backups: back up Regram's data to Google Drive (on a schedule) or a file, then restore or reset each feature on its own. Older exports still open in Older Backups.
- New Storage & Files: see what takes space, browse IG's folders, clean up caches and set auto clear.
- New IG API page (Settings > App): requests per feature, cache hits, hourly & daily limits, and a live "Paused until…" when IG rate limits or flags the account. Pauses survive relaunch; your own taps are never stopped.
- Background checks (watchlist, follow requests, Media Watch, Save All) now share one paced queue: no burst of requests when IG opens. Checks you start yourself still run at once.
- Chats: action button now also on photos & videos opened in a chat (normal and disappearing): save to Vault, share, expand, repost and more. Same menu as view-once media.
- New Hide in Stories Bar (Ads & Clutter > Stories): hide suggested accounts and recent highlights from the stories bar.
- New video player (Vault, Downloads, Expand): pinch to zoom, double-tap left/right to skip, hold for 2x, speed menu, exact-frame scrubbing, Picture in Picture, AirPlay and Save Frame (to Photos or Vault).
- Clear Cache moved into Storage & Files (Clean Up and Auto Clear). Your Auto Clear schedule carries over.
- Hide UI in Screenshots: now also hides the Quick Controls button in chats and the glass background of all Regram buttons (iOS 26+).
- Feed & profile action buttons: glass now matches IG's buttons (stays solid when Liquid Glass is set to Clear) and bounces when tapped or held.
- New Activity Status button in the chats list: turn your online status on or off in one tap, hold it for more options. Also in Quick Controls.
- Stories action button: new L

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes and compatibility updates for IG 451 and 452.
- Reels Limit: fixed crash when opening a reel from feed on IG 452.
- Messages Only: own settings page, switches in place (no restart), automatic schedule (times + days, switch instantly or ask first), optional Profile tab, Shortcuts links.
- Remove Tracking from Links: now also strips IG's new random tracking params (e.g. ?rpxt=, ?dlrf=).
- Follow Requests: warns before you send a follow request to someone who rejected one before (on by default).
- Follow Requests: new Received tab — tracks who asks to follow you and whether you approved, declined or they withdrew. Confirm/Delete right from the list, repeat requesters marked, new requests badged. Turn on Track Received Requests in settings.
- Follow Requests: redesigned list with filter chips (with counts) and clearer empty states.
- Reels Buttons: hide the new Shop Similar button.
- Feed: option to hide the full screen button that pops up over reels.
- Explore: option to hide the Suggested for you accounts in search. Hide Search History now also hides the empty Recent header.
- Media Watch: fixed new posts not being saved; posts that failed to save are retried; refresh says when it's paused.
- Media Watch: Select All in the Media screen, and Delete All Saved Media for every account at once (accounts list or settings).
- Profile Tracking: Watchlist can sort by Recently visited again (default while visits are recorded), so opened profiles move to the top.
- Restart alert: clearer buttons (Restart Now / Later) and says your change is already saved.
- Fixed ads (and Hide Reels) in the Explore grid.
- Fixed Profile Tracking badges on profiles not opening when tapped.
- Fixed IG freezing on Reels when the Share button is hidden.
- Fixed custom tabs not opening after adding or logging out of an account.
- Fixed profiles from Stories Archive viewers and other lists closing all screens first instead of opening on top.

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes and compatibility updates for IG 450.1.
- New Story Playback Controls: speed, scrubbing, skip, volume, mute, Picture in Picture, save frame and next person for stories. Open with a long-press on •••, the new playback button or the action button. Stop Auto Advance moved there too.
- Reels Playback Controls: new previous/next reel and skip buttons (5s by default). When paused, skip steps one frame; hold to repeat. Also available as floating button actions.
- New Media Watch (Profile Tracking): watched accounts can have their new stories, posts, reels and profile pictures saved automatically, shown in the events list and viewable there.
- New per-account Media screen: all saved media by type, a Deleted filter, full-screen viewer, and export to Photos or the Vault.
- Profile Tracking now centers on the Watchlist: it opens on Watchlist | Changes, and recording profile visits is optional (off by default).
- Profile Tracking: now tracks links and their titles, pronouns, category, account type and contact info.
- Profile Tracking: fixed false profile picture changes, mostly on accounts without a picture.
- New Save All Media on the profile action button: posts, carousels, reels, stories and the profile picture in bulk.
- Instants: new Manually Mark as Seen. Viewed instants stay unseen until you tap the eye button.
- Reel Buttons: hide IG's new Save button on Reels, or just its count.
- Redesigned Tab Bar editor: live preview, add or hide tabs with + and −, and changes apply without relaunching.
- Tab Bar: add custom tabs, like IG's Saved and Notifications or Regram screens such as the Vault, Downloads and Settings.
- Tab Bar: hold any tab to open a screen of your choice (Home still opens Regram Settings).
- Detect IG Links moved to the Tab Bar editor as Explore's hold action (your setting carries over).
- Stacked Toast notifications now share one width instead of zig-zagging.
- Downloads: filter chips above the list, plus a Select button to delete many downloads at once, with or without their media.
- Fixed Hide Chats and the DM refresh confirmation not working on IG's new chats list.
- Fixed video Instants downloading as a photo.
- Fixed IG crashing at launch on some accounts.

apps.name: RNGTool
apps.subtitle: The best way to generate random numbers on iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
RNGTool is the best and easiest way to generate random numbers, roll some dice, draw some cards, and select random letters, right from your iPhone (or iPad)!

## Modes
### Numbers
Generate a single random number using only a minimum and maximum number. The simplest way to generate numbers. Now features fancy animations if run on iOS 16+ or macOS 13+!
### Coins
Flip some coins! Displays the total coins flipped and how many were heads or tails. Supports flipping up to 100 consecutive coins on macOS, 50 consecutive coins on iOS, and single coins on watchOS.
### Dice
Generate numbers using your standard 6-sided dice. Supports up to 18 dice on macOS, 9 dice on iOS, and 2 dice on watchOS.
### Cards
Generate numbers by drawing a hand of cards. Optionally, you can display the point values of each card drawn, with the Ace being toggleable between 1 and 11 points. Supports up to 10 cards on macOS, 7 cards on iOS, and 3 cards on watchOS.
### Marbles
Generate letters by rolling some marbles. Supports up to 18 marbles on macOS, 9 marbles on iOS, and 3 marbles on watchOS.

RNGTool is fully open source, and the source can be found [on GitHub](https://github.com/NCX-Programming/RNGTool). You can also find the macOS version there.

Note that a watchOS extension app for RNGTool exists, but is currently unsupported by AltStore/SideStore. Should it become supported, it will be added here, however you will need to install the IPA manually for now if you want it. RNGTool is also available for macOS in the GitHub repository.

versions.localizedDescription:
### General
- The title on the main menu now proudly proclaims "RNGTool" instead of "Home".
- The "Interface" settings category has been renamed to "General" and has been moved to the top of the settings screen.
- Toggles for generator animations have been removed from each mode's settings and are instead unified into one "Play animations in supported modes" toggle under General.
  - As a result, dice and marble modes no longer have dedicated settings sections, as their only option was to enable animations.
- The "Credits" section of the About RNGTool page has been removed, as it was mostly unnecessary and contained credits not relevant to RNGTool.
- The copyright year now extends to the current year instead of just specifying 2022.
- I added a credit for myself at the bottom and there's nothing you can do about it.
- Advanced settings is now a proper settings page rather than a sheet, which resolves an issue on iPad where it would be dismissed at inopportune times.
- All modes have been entirely redesigned to have clearer controls and to occupy more of the screen space, so you can finally justify the cost of your M4 iPad Pro.
- Modes no longer inappropriately use scroll views, so you can't scroll through a page of nothingness anymore.
- The generate and reset buttons have been enlarged across all modes and no longer look like they're trying to hide from RNGTool's terrifying former design.
- All modes now have a dedicated generate button, because sometimes you don't want to have to handle the marbles if someone else has had their hands all over them. That's gross.

### Number Mode
- The maximum and minimum text fields are now always exposed, because hiding them away seemed a bit silly when there was so much open space.
- There's now a super fancy animation that plays when you generate a number, though it's only supported on iOS 16+. Sorry iOS 15 users. iOS 17+ users get a slightly cooler animation that changes based on whether the new number was greater than or less than the previous one.

### New Mode: Coin Mode
- You can finally flip a coin from the convenience of your RNGTool!
- Supports up to 50 coin flips in one go, with a charming haptic tap for each one.

### Dice Mode
- The dice now wrap quite nicely, so you now only get 3 per row.
- As a result, I could fit 3 extra dice in! Wow! That's a total of 9!
- You can now shake your device to roll! This feature is sure to amaze your friends. (This feature can be disabled using the "Shake your device to generate in supported models" toggle in general settings.)

### Card Mode
- The cards are now above the controls, because I felt like it was really weird that it was the only mode where the content was below the controls.

### Marble Mode
- By using the same dark magic as dice mode, I've enabled wrapping and increased the maximum to 9 for marbles as well.
- The entire space of the marble is now tappable. Previously you needed to hit either the outer circle or the letter, because the visual empty space inside of the marble wasn't actually part of the marble. This might not have been a huge deal on iPhone, but on iPad you could manage to miss the actual marble.
- Also using the same dark magic as dice mode, device shaking! You can now shake your device to roll marbles. (This feature can also be disabled using the "Shake your device to generate in supported models" toggle in general settings.)

## v2.0.0: State restoration!
### What's new on iOS:
- Interface settings are now separate from advanced settings and are shown in the main settings screen.
    - These settings include "Ask to confirm resets" and "Show tap hints".
- Number Mode now saves your result, max number and min number while the app is running.
    - A toggle has been added to advanced settings to disable this.
- Number settings now saves your default numbers as you type.
- Default numbers now reset correctly.
- The text on the marbles in Marble Mode now scales with the display size.

apps.subtitle: Get more than an app store. Get Scarlet.
apps.localizedDescription:
NOTE: The developer does not change the version (1.0), so if you see new features online or if the app stops working, uninstall and reinstall the app. The download link on AltStore is from the official website so what you download here will always be the latest.

Also, getting scarlet from AltStore means that you will never lose the app if you keep refreshing - downloading it from the official website will likely result in the certificate being revoked and you have to wait for it to be resigned.


Why Us?

Scarlet offers a new community for developers to submit their paid apps, allowing users to seamlessly protect themselves from revokes. Our goal getting into Scarlet is to give everybody access to a store that doesn't tell people to do the workarounds. Instead, we created an app with every user in mind to bring a smooth experience.


True repo system

Scarlet offers the first ever true repo system for all users.
What is a true repo system ? - Our repo system supports jailbreak repos and jailed users can make use of some features added to the side.
These include 1. Force install jailbroken apps while jailed
2. Automatically/Manually injects the tweak into the app it's meant for(no jailbreak required)

We include native repos specifically designed for Scarlet. Developers have the ability to choose a dylibs/debs to inject into the specificed app.
 

Made by Pros

Scarlet's GUI was designed by Xeviks.
He has brought color, vibrancy, movement, and modernity - yet keeping the look simplistic.
DebianArch is the solo-dev of the Scarlet app and is bringing innovative features to reshape the community that was left unchanged.

apps.name: ScummVM
apps.subtitle: Point and click adventures.
apps.localizedDescription:
ScummVM is a program which allows you to run certain classic graphical point-and-click adventure games and role-playing games, provided you already have their data files. The clever part about this: ScummVM just replaces the executables shipped with the games, allowing you to play them on systems for which they were never designed!

ScummVM supports a huge library of adventures with over 250 games in total. It supports many classics published by legendary studios like LucasArts, Sierra On-Line, Revolution Software, Cyan, Inc. and Westwood Studios. Next to ground-breaking titles like the Monkey Island series, Broken Sword, Myst, Blade Runner and countless other games you will find some really obscure adventures and truly hidden gems to explore.

apps.subtitle: The original Spotilife tweak, along with other tweaks
apps.localizedDescription:
USE THIS IF YOU DO NOT LIKE THE NEW ONE OR IF ITS NOT WORKING

I would highly recommend you use the new Spotify tweak as it has been updated to work on newer Spotify versions and is currently being updated. However this tweak may stop working in the near future as it is an old version.



Spotify++ contants a tweak that activates Premium. As well as a number of tweaks to customise the UI and improve the overall user experience.

Here are the following tweaks:

• Spotilife - Premium for free.

• Sposify - A Tweak to customize your Spotify App UI and expand functionalities.

• Volify - Adds a volume slider to Spotify.

• SpotifyAllowSetting - Allows you to access all of the settings in Spotify that are normally disabled when someone else is playing music from another device.

• SpotifyNoPodcasts - Hides Podcasts from from Home and Library

• SpotifyHighQuality - Enables 'Very High' Quality in Audio Quality settings

•TrueShuffle - Enables true random shuffling (Spotify prioritizes Songs you have listened to more often by default)

• Spoticentre - Centres the song/artist in now playing (Only working on some devices)



NOTE

The ‘Car’ setting has been replaced with the sposify tweak settings so unfortunatley you cannot change car settings - all good tho, nobody use that shi anyways, and when car view enables when u in the car, just click ‘turn off car view’ at the top right corner.

- Stream all TV shows and Movies from multiple websites without any annoying ads

- Supports multi-language subtitles for iOS and tvOS

versions.localizedDescription:
# V 1.3.0 Release

🔍 Sora Search Integration
Global search now includes results from Sora modules. Easily add supported add-ons from the Sora Library. https://sora.jm26.net/library/

📺 Stremio Add-ons Support
Now supports Stremio Subtitles and Live TV add-ons for a richer streaming experience.

🎥 MPV Player with Dolby Vision Support
New MPV video engine enables high-quality playback, including full Dolby Vision support.

🌍 Universal Resolver Upgrade (Torrentio & Comet)
Improved source resolving with smarter Comet integration and enhanced Torrentio settings.

🧑‍🎨 Redesigned Stremio UI
Updated interface with new media icons, improved layout, and smoother navigation.

📱 iOS 15 Compatibility
The app now runs smoothly on older iOS 15 devices.

📂 External Subtitles Add-on Support
Easily connect external subtitle sources for greater flexibility.

🔄 Trakt Integration Fixes
More reliable syncing of favorites and watch history, with improved handling of default keys and icons.



NOTE: BundleIdentifier changed in this version and automatic updates have been disabled until manual install occurs.

# V 1.2.42 Release 📢 Release Update – Exciting Fixes & Improvements! We’re back with a fresh update packed with key fixes and improvements to enhance your streaming experience! 🎉 ✅ Trakt Integration Fixed We’ve resolved the issues with Trakt integration, ensuring that your watch history, progress tracking, and syncing work seamlessly across devices. 📺 Anime Now Pulls Season 2 Episodes Anime fans, rejoice! 🎌 Season 2 episodes are now properly detected and displayed, so you won’t miss a single moment of your favorite series. 🔧 Fixed Several Providers We’ve gone under the hood and fixed multiple content providers, ensuring better reliability, faster loading, and improved stream availability. 🐛 Various Bug Fixes & Performance Enhancements From small glitches to UI tweaks, we’ve tackled a range of bugs to make everything smoother and more stable. 🚀 More Updates Coming Soon! This is just the beginning! We’re actively working on more improvements, new features, and optimizations—stay tuned for even bigger things ahead! Enjoy the update & happy streaming! 🎬🍿

# V 1.2.38 Release - **New Feature: Custom Stremio Addon Support** - You can now add your own custom Stremio addons to Streamer! These addons currently support IMDB and direct links, but torrent support is not available. Most self-hosted addons should work seamlessly. - **Enhancements: Jackett and Annatar Configurations** - We've updated the support for Jackett and Annatar configurations. Enjoy improved performance and compatibility. - **Bug Fixes and New Provider: Filma24** - The Flixtor provider has been fixed, and we've also added a new Albanian provider called Filma24. - Additionally, this release includes various small bug fixes and overall improvements. NOTE: BundleIdentifier changed in this version and automatic updates have been disabled until manual install occurs.

apps.name: SUMEE! Lite
apps.subtitle: SUMEE is a highly stylized, nostalgic iOS launcher and frontend inspired by the PS Vita interface and the Frutiger Aero design language.
apps.localizedDescription:
SUMEE (Lite)

⚠️ Important Update: This repository is a refactored Lite fork of my original SUMEE! codebase. The work focused on reducing project size, splitting large files into smaller modules, and improving maintainability. English ↔ Spanish translation tasks were also streamlined in this version.

SUMEE is a highly stylized, nostalgic iOS launcher and frontend inspired by the PS Vita interface and the Frutiger Aero design language.
Project Context (Important)
This repository is a refactored Lite fork of the original SUMEE! project, based on my own original codebase.
To build SUMEE Lite, I used AI as a development assistant to help reduce and reorganize parts of the original SUMEE! codebase into a smaller, more modular structure.
Main goal of this fork:
- Make SUMEE! smaller and easier to maintain.
- Split large files/features into smaller, modular components.
- Keep behavior and design identity while improving readability and iteration speed.
About development workflow:
- Core architecture, app logic, and project direction are authored manually.
- Refactoring focused on decomposition into reusable pieces (views, managers, and feature modules).
- English ↔ Spanish translation tasks were also made easier during this refactor process.
AI Usage in the Codebase
AI tools were used as targeted support to speed up refactoring, cleanup, and writing tasks.
However, the project design, core architecture, and technical decisions behind SUMEE! Lite are original work and are maintained manually.
It transforms your iOS navigation experience with 3D bubble icons, "LiveArea" style app pages, floating cartridges, and a fully functional system interface including Music, Photos, and Game integrations.
Join our Discord
Features

Vita-Style Home Screen:
Vertical scrolling pages with 3D, physics-based bubble icons.
"Wobble" edit mode and drag-and-drop organization.


LiveArea Interface:
Launch apps into a "LiveArea" gate before entering.
Peel-to-Close: Use the signature "peel" gesture (top-right corner) to close apps and games. Includes haptic feedback!


System Apps:
Music Player: Floating mini-player and full-screen visualization.
Photos: Integrated gallery viewer.
Settings: Comprehensive customization (Lite Mode, Performance Mode, Custom Themes).


Emulation Frontend:
Built-in support for launching and managing ROMs (requires appropriate backend/core setup).


Aesthetics:
Frutiger Aero gloss and depth.
Dynamic backgrounds and floating particle effects.
Custom "Lite Mode" for older devices to ensure smooth 60fps performance.



Prerequisites

macOS with the latest version of Xcode (15.0+ recommended).
iOS Device matching the deployment target (iOS 15.0+).
Apple ID (for signing).

Getting Started
1. Clone the Repository
bash
git clone https://github.com/getzemani63/sumee-lite.git
cd sumee-lite
2. Open in Xcode
Double-click on SUMEE!.xcodeproj to open the project.
3. Configure Signing

Click on the SUMEE project icon in the top-left project navigator.
Select the SUMEE target under "Targets".
Go to the Signing & Capabilities tab.
Select your Team from the dropdown menu.
Ensure the Bundle Identifier is unique (e.g., change com.sumee.app to com.yourname.sumee) if you don't have access to the original team profile.

4. Run the App

Connect your iOS device via USB.
Select your device from the generic device list in the top toolbar.
Press Cmd + R or click the Play button to build and run.


Note: If running on a physical device for the first time, you may need to trust your developer profile in Settings > General > VPN & Device Management on your iPhone/iPad.


Building an IPA (For Sideloading)
To verify the app or share it (e.g., via AltStore, SideStore, or TrollStore), you need to export an .ipa file.


Select "Any iOS Device (arm64)":

In the device selector (top toolbar), choose Any iOS Device (arm64) instead of a specific connected phone.



Archive:

Go to Product > Archive in the menu bar.
Xcode will build the project. This may take a few minutes.



Distribute App:

Once the Organizer window appears with your archive selected, click Distribute App.
Select Custom (or Ad Hoc / Development depending on your Xcode version options).
Choose App Thinning: None (to make it compatible with all devices) or select your specific model.
Signing: Select Automatically manage signing or manually select your profile.



Export:

Choose a destination folder on your Mac.
Xcode will generate a folder containing SUMEE.ipa.



You can now sideload this SUMEE.ipa using tools like AltServer or SideStore.
Contributing
Contributions are welcome. Please read CONTRIBUTING.md before opening a Pull Request.
Acknowledgements
See ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md.
License
This project is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
See LICENSE.
Emulator Licenses
This project uses the following Libretro cores for emulation. Each core is subject to its own license:

NES: FCEUmm (GPL v2)
SNES: Snes9x (Non-commercial)
GBA: mGBA (MPL 2.0)
DS: melonDS (GPL v3)
PSX: PCSX ReARMed (GPL v2)
Genesis/Mega Drive: PicoDrive (MAME / GPL v2)

versions.localizedDescription:
This release introduces major aesthetic upgrades with video background support, significantly improves theme management, and polishes the gamepad experience.
New Features

Video Backgrounds: You can now use .mp4 files as custom backgrounds! The theme system now supports importing and displaying video loops.
Persistent Theme Library: Imported themes are now saved permanently in a dedicated Documents/Themes folder. They will remain available even after restarting the app.

Theme Manager Upgrade:

Instant Loading: Optimized the theme list to load instantly without lag.
Visual Separator: Imported themes are now clearly separated from default system themes.
Original Filenames: Imported themes now keep their original filenames (e.g., MyCoolTheme.json) instead of being renamed to timestamps.

Improvements & Fixes

Gamepad Launch Animation: Fixed a visual glitch where launching a game with the controller ("A" button) didn't use the correct animation coordinates. It now perfectly matches the touch interaction.
DS Audio Fix: Resolved audio stuttering issues when resuming DS games.
BIOS Selection: Fixed issues with BIOS file selection stability.

SUMEE! Lite v1.0.0 - Initial Release
Key Features
Vita UI: Authentic bubble interface with physics, wobble mode, and folder support.
LiveArea: Interactive app pages with "Peel-to-Close" gestures and haptic feedback.
Built-in Emulation: Integrated cores for seamless gaming:
NES (FCEUmm)
SNES (Snes9x)
GBA (mGBA)
DS (melonDS)
PSX (PCSX ReARMed)
Genesis (PicoDrive)
System Apps: Music (Visualize), Photos, and Settings.
Lite Mode: Optimization for older devices (iPhone 7/8/SE/XR) ensuring smooth 60fps.
Notes
Sideloading: Use AltStore, SideStore, or TrollStore to install the .ipa.
Bios/ROMs: You must provide your own game files.
License: This project is free and open source under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Commercial use is prohibited.

apps.name: TrollInstallerX
apps.subtitle: The universal TrollStore installer for iOS 14.0 - 17.0.0.0 beta 4
apps.localizedDescription:
Overview

TrollInstallerX is a universal TrollStore installer. It focuses on being extremely reliable and easy to use. It is also very fast, being able to install TrollStore and/or its persistence helper in a matter of seconds on the latest devices.

TrollInstallerX supports all devices running iOS 14.0 - 16.6.1, both arm64 and arm64e. It makes use of one of two different methods to install TrollStore, depending on what device and iOS you have. These methods are:

• Direct installation: using the kfd kernel exploit, along with the dmaFail PPL bypass on iOS 15.2+ arm64e devices, TrollInstallerX can install both TrollStore and its persistence helper directly onto the device without having to leave the installer.

   - Supports iOS 14.0 - 16.6.1 (arm64) and iOS 14.0 - 16.5.1 (arm64e).
      • Note: A15, A16, and M2 devices on iOS 16.5.1 do not support this method.
      • Note: A8 devices are only supported on iOS 14.0 - 15.1 for the time being.
• Indirect installation: Using the kfd kernel exploit, TrollInstallerX can replace a system application of your choice with the TrollStore persistence helper. This method only exists due to both the lack of a PPL bypass on iOS 16.6 and above, as well as the fact that dmaFail is non-functional on A15, A16, and M2 devices on iOS 16.5.1.

   - Supports iOS 16.5.1 - 16.6.1 (arm64e).
      • Note: This method is the only method that supports A15, A16, and M2 devices on iOS 16.5.1.

Both methods allow you to install a persistence helper into a removable system app. The reason that this is needed is due to the way that the CoreTrust bug (used by TrollStore) works - in certain circumstances, TrollStore and other apps installed by it will be reset to User registration, instead of System. You cannot open any of these apps until you have used the persistence helper to set them back to System registration.


Usage

TrollInstallerX is extremely easy to use. Simply download the latest release from the Releases page, and sideload it using your preferred method. Once installed, open the app and press the "Install" button. From there, TrollStore and/or its persistence helper will be installed onto your device.

TrollInstallerX will automatically choose the best exploit for your device. However, in some cases, you may want to choose a specific exploit. To do this, simply open the settings view and select the exploit that you want to use. Once you have selected it, press the "Install TrollStore" button and TrollInstallerX will use the exploit you have chosen.

Note: iOS 16.2 - 16.6.1 and iOS 15.7.2 - 15.8.2 require an internet connection in order for TrollInstallerX to download the kernelcache and patchfind it.

• Removing confusing logging around exploit deinitialisation
• Fix arm64e devices on iOS 15.7.x that couldn't download the kernelcache by updating libgrabkernel2

apps.name: UTM
apps.subtitle: UTM - Run virtual machines on iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
UTM is a full featured system emulator and virtual machine host for iOS and macOS. It is based off of QEMU. In short, it allows you to run Windows, Linux, and more on your Mac, iPhone, and iPad. More information at https://getutm.app/ and https://mac.getutm.app/
Status: ✅

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.

## Changes (v5.0.8)
* Fixed several changes listed for v5.0.7 being left out of that build by mistake.
* (macOS) Fixed Windows 3D acceleration on Apple Silicon Macs without Rosetta by falling back to DXMT
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows installs from the USB CD drive stalling repeatedly, which made them much slower in v5.0.7 (#7970)

## Changes (v5.0.7)
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration
* QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson)
* (macOS 15) QEMU: Better performance on Apple Silicon

## Highlights
* **QEMU v10.0.2**: The backend has been updated to the latest upstream QEMU which brings with it a variety of bug fixes and performance improvements.
* **Liquid Glass**: UTM adopts the Liquid Glass design on *OS 26.
* **App Intents**: New support for automation with Shortcuts.
* **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Define custom key combinations (such as Ctrl+Alt+Del) that can be sent to the VM from the new Keyboard menu.
* **Improved Wizard**: Simplify the creation of emulated machines by selecting from a list of well-supported configurations. The updated wizard can create more working configurations such as RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x, and Windows 95/98.

## Changes (v4.7.5)
* Fixed some rare conditions that could lead to a VM fail to start and spin infinitely
* Fixed some rare crashes that can happen after a VM stops
* Fixed parsing of file paths with commas in the name (thanks @nikolan123)
* ANGLE: Fixed a memory leak issue in the GLES backend (#7546) (thanks @cnnn)
* ANGLE: Fixed a memory leak issue in the Metal backend (#4958)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (macOS) Fixed App Intents on macOS 26 (#7412) (thanks @peterneutron)
* (macOS) Fixed an error when file locking is disabled and a removable drive with no image selected is started (#7527)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed shared directory disconnecting when window is resized (#7488) (thanks @evan314159)
* Hotfix: (1/3/25) An earlier release of v4.7.5 has an issue that prevented VMs from starting. Make sure you are on build 118.

## Changes (v4.7.4)
* (macOS) Fixed a crash on VM start when a toolbar menu was reinitialized (note v4.7.4 was re-released to address this) (#7408)
* Home: Fixed layout issue with button titles
* (macOS) Fixed a crash when VM exits while USB is active
* (iOS) Support for StikDebug on iOS 26 (non-SE only)

## Changes (v4.7.3)
* Fixed a crash when starting a VM results in a block device error
* Stop button can now be used a second time to force kill a VM if it is unresponsive after stopping for the first time
* libusb: Fixed multiple race conditions that caused crashes when using USB capture
* CocoaSpice: Fixed multiple race conditions that caused crashes during VM start
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed broken commands due to name collision (#7360)
* (macOS) Fixed crash when exiting full screen (#7377)

## Changes (v4.7.2)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed a crash when starting any Apple Virtualization VM (#7355) (We are re-releasing v4.7.2 with build 112 due to this critical bug.)
* Home: Display network details and active IP addresses on the home details screen (thanks @gabefair)
* Home: Show a security warning message when importing a .utm with custom arguments (#6252)
* Config: Option to reset UEFI without pre-loading Secure Boot keys (useful for custom TPM configurations) (#7005)
* Config: Pre-loading Secure Boot keys will now install Microsoft UEFI 2023 certificates (#7257)
* Config: When PS/2 device is enabled, no longer create USB mouse and keyboard devices. This allows older Windows install to work out of the box.
* Config: Quotes in custom arguments are no longer stripped (unless the only quotes wrap the entire argument) (#6343)
* Config: Provide a fixed serial number for VirtIO block devices (#7332)
* QEMU: Fixed an issue which causes Windows 98 to BSoD (#7342)
* QEMU: Do not create a default floppy drive when -nodefaults is used. UTM configuration will set up a FDC device and this is the only way to set up bootindex for floppy.
* Wizard: Legacy Windows configurations will now use PS/2 controller by default
* Wizard: Update OS logos to be consistent with other icons
* Wizard: Windows + i440fx hardware will now instantiate default devices (sound, VGA, networking) that should work with Windows 95/98
* Wizard: Add additional supported hardware configurations for running older Windows

* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.

## Changes (v5.0.7)
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration
* QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson)
* (macOS 15) QEMU: Better performance on Apple Silicon with the Hypervisor.framework built-in interrupt controller
* (macOS) Scripting: Force stopping a paused VM is now allowed
* (macOS 27) AVF: Explain when a USB device such as a webcam or phone can't be passed through, instead of showing "VZErrorDomain error -6" (#7914)
* (macOS) Guest Agent: Fixed an

## Highlights
* **QEMU v10.0.2**: The backend has been updated to the latest upstream QEMU which brings with it a variety of bug fixes and performance improvements.
* **Liquid Glass**: UTM adopts the Liquid Glass design on *OS 26.
* **App Intents**: New support for automation with Shortcuts.
* **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Define custom key combinations (such as Ctrl+Alt+Del) that can be sent to the VM from the new Keyboard menu.
* **Improved Wizard**: Simplify the creation of emulated machines by selecting from a list of well-supported configurations. The updated wizard can create more working configurations such as RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x, and Windows 95/98.

## Changes (v4.7.5)
* Fixed some rare conditions that could lead to a VM fail to start and spin infinitely
* Fixed some rare crashes that can happen after a VM stops
* Fixed parsing of file paths with commas in the name (thanks @nikolan123)
* ANGLE: Fixed a memory leak issue in the GLES backend (#7546) (thanks @cnnn)
* ANGLE: Fixed a memory leak issue in the Metal backend (#4958)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (macOS) Fixed App Intents on macOS 26 (#7412) (thanks @peterneutron)
* (macOS) Fixed an error when file locking is disabled and a removable drive with no image selected is started (#7527)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed shared directory disconnecting when window is resized (#7488) (thanks @evan314159)
* Hotfix: (1/3/25) An earlier release of v4.7.5 has an issue that prevented VMs from starting. Make sure you are on build 118.

## Changes (v4.7.4)
* (macOS) Fixed a crash on VM start when a toolbar menu was reinitialized (note v4.7.4 was re-released to address this) (#7408)
* Home: Fixed layout issue with button titles
* (macOS) Fixed a crash when VM exits while USB is active
* (iOS) Support for StikDebug on iOS 26 (non-SE only)

## Changes (v4.7.3)
* Fixed a crash when starting a VM results in a block device error
* Stop button can now be used a second time to force kill a VM if it is unresponsive after stopping for the first time
* libusb: Fixed multiple race conditions that caused crashes when using USB capture
* CocoaSpice: Fixed multiple race conditions that caused crashes during VM start
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed broken commands due to name collision (#7360)
* (macOS) Fixed crash when exiting full screen (#7377)

## Changes (v4.7.2)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed a crash when starting any Apple Virtualization VM (#7355) (We are re-releasing v4.7.2 with build 112 due to this critical bug.)
* Home: Display network details and active IP addresses on the home details screen (thanks @gabefair)
* Home: Show a security warning message when importing a .utm with custom arguments (#6252)
* Config: Option to reset UEFI without pre-loading Secure Boot keys (useful for custom TPM configurations) (#7005)
* Config: Pre-loading Secure Boot keys will now install Microsoft UEFI 2023 certificates (#7257)
* Config: When PS/2 device is enabled, no longer create USB mouse and keyboard devices. This allows older Windows install to work out of the box.
* Config: Quotes in custom arguments are no longer stripped (unless the only quotes wrap the entire argument) (#6343)
* Config: Provide a fixed serial number for VirtIO block devices (#7332)
* QEMU: Fixed an issue which causes Windows 98 to BSoD (#7342)
* QEMU: Do not create a default floppy drive when -nodefaults is used. UTM configuration will set up a FDC device and this is the only way to set up bootindex for floppy.
* Wizard: Legacy Windows configurations will now use PS/2 controller by default
* Wizard: Update OS logos to be consistent with other icons
* Wizard: Windows + i440fx hardware will now instantiate default devices (sound, VGA, networking) that should work with Windows 95/98
* Wizard: Add additional supported hardware configurations for running older Windows
